summary_md: **Oai Chu ([@oaichu95](https://x.com/oaichu95/status/2115480484994228256))** highlights **SenseNova 6.8 Code2Video**, a 27B open-weight (Apache 2.0, 512K context) model that writes code which renders video, so edits are code changes rather than re-generations; weights are on Hugging Face.
relevance: An open ~30B model that makes video generation programmable, bridging local models and agentic media.
